lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a non-uniform grid posterior to the gill slits. The spots increase in diameter and spatial separation as they progress posteriorly along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the primary spot rows, forming a grid-like structure across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity dorsal pixels to shadowed ventral pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple superficial horizontal linear markings or scratches are visible on the anterior snout and head region, appearing as low-contrast white lines against the darker base tissue.
other_distinctive_markers: The primary pectoral fin exhibits a high-density clustering of small-diameter high-luminance spots, distinct from the larger, more spaced patterning on the main torso.
